name: Disenchant: Woodchipper Dagger can be disenchanted (COA-7000)
contract: The Woodchipper Dagger 53452 is an uncommon item level 11 one-hand dagger, the same class, subclass, slot, quality and item level as the stock Small Hand Blade 816, whose disenchant bracket is 21 (Lesser Magic Essence 10938 or Strange Dust 10940, required skill 1). A character with Enchanting 300 casting Disenchant 13262 on the dagger gets a disenchant loot window with exactly one item from that bracket, and closing it consumes the dagger.

steps.label: the disenchant loot window holds one item
closing the loot window consumes the dagger
